intent: setup_zram.sh and setup_zswap.sh never exit 0 while the next boot would run a different swap setup: a stale grub.cfg is rebuilt, and an unfixable boot config fails loudly before live swap changes.
scope: Non-goal: the host (systemd-boot) is not touched or rebooted
changes: _ss_set_grub rebuilds grub.cfg when the defaults changed OR any grub.cfg linux line does not carry exactly the target zswap words (missing file counts), then re-checks and exits 1 naming the offending line
ss_set_boot_tokens checks every systemd-boot entry's options lines carry the target words and exits 1 naming the entry otherwise
Harness grub-mkconfig stub writes an Arch-like grub.cfg (tab-indented linux lines, recovery from GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX); snapshot includes grub.cfg
vmbox_swap.sh: new stale-zram, stale-zswap and noopts phases; grub.cfg checks every linux line; again compares grub.cfg mtime

verification.evidence: Before the fix: 53 passed, 15 failed (stale grub.cfg not rebuilt, missing options line exited 0). After: 68 passed, 0 failed

verification.command: vm run zc3 'sudo bash ~/wt/linux_configuration/fixes/lib/tests/vmbox_swap.sh <phase>' (fresh BIOS/GRUB guest zc3 after vm hibernate-setup)
verification.evidence: zswap -> reboot -> booted-zswap OK; stale-zram RC=0 (precondition grub.cfg boots zswap; all 2 linux lines carry zswap.enabled=0) -> reboot -> booted-zram OK (cmdline zswap.enabled=0, zram0 prio 100 zstd, zswap N) -> again OK (md5, mtime, swap list unchanged); stale-zswap RC=0 (all 2 lines carry the 4 tokens) -> reboot -> booted-zswap OK -> again OK; noopts on zram and on zswap: exit 1 naming b.conf, GRUB files, swap list and zswap enabled unchanged

risks: A grub.cfg whose kernel lines are not named `linux` (linux16/linuxefi) would read as having no matching line and be rebuilt each run, then fail loudly
A systemd-boot UKI entry without an options line now makes the scripts exit 1 instead of silently skipping it
rollback: git revert the commit; setup_*.sh go back to rebuilding grub.cfg only when /etc/default/grub changed
